description: Read-only full verified record for one product. Returns `matches` and up to 3 `records`; each record has `dataset`, `plans` (name, monthly and annual price, metering unit, limits per window), `rates` (per-unit prices such as $/min or $/1M tokens, each with the vendor `quote`), `free` tier, `overage` policy, `gotchas` (billing traps), `sources` (URLs) and `checked` date. Match by id (e.g. "claude", "cursor", "vapi", "openai-api") or by product name, case-insensitive; exact match wins, otherwise a substring match. Returns an error listing the candidates when the name is ambiguous or unknown. Prices are USD. `published: false` means the vendor states no number and the `value` is their wording; never estimate from it.

dataset.description: Dataset id to search in, when the same id exists in several. One of: ai-plans, usage, email-sending, llm-apis, media, plans-new, scraping-proxies, search-apis, voice. Omit to cover every dataset.

tool_id.description: Product id from list_tools, or the product name (e.g. "cursor", "Retell AI", "gemini-api").

name: get_tool
title: Get one product record
